resources.string: Free • No logs • No account • No ads

While connected, no app can bypass the tunnel and the tunnel stays up across reconnects. For a full system-level kill switch, also enable “Always-on VPN” + “Block connections without VPN” in Android Settings.

Free volunteer servers (VPN Gate). Speeds vary and servers can disappear. The server operator can see connection metadata (destination IPs); HTTPS traffic stays encrypted end-to-end. This app itself collects nothing.
